title: Admit Source-Backed BoM Evidence
entryCriteria: Architecture is reviewable enough to identify critical component candidates.
exitCriteria: Every critical BoM line has admitted supplier, manufacturer, MPN, unit cost and source reference. BoM provenance manifest has zero critical missing-source claims.
rationale: Critical BoM costs, suppliers, manufacturers and MPNs must be source-backed before cost claims are credible.

title: Complete Engineering Review
entryCriteria: Calculations and assumptions have named scope, formula or model basis.
exitCriteria: All calculation and assumption review rows are accepted, revised or explicitly deferred with reviewer rationale.
rationale: Deterministic arithmetic can expose claims, but engineering judgment must review envelopes, assumptions and operating cases.

title: Accept Reviewer Evidence
entryCriteria: Verification intake template has non-source activities ready for reviewer evidence.
exitCriteria: Every non-source verification activity is accepted, or explicitly deferred and removed from publication criteria.
rationale: Reviewer acceptance is tracked separately from deterministic scoring and must close before publication.

title: Repair Remaining Section Scores
entryCriteria: All directly closable evidence rows have been processed, but deterministic section score gaps remain.
exitCriteria: Every scored report section is at or above target and readiness verdict is publishable.
rationale: After evidence intake, rerun scoring to remove residual deterministic section blockers.
